messages:
maya: quick sync — starting a hosted-api roadmap thread for the next quarter. goal: unify launch criteria across chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank so we can ship a cohesive enterprise package. need alignment on SLA, perf budgets, telemetry, and migration plan. who can take owner for launch checklist?

liam: I can own runtime perf budgets. need to confirm target p95 latency per route and acceptable cost delta for customers on Dedicated vs Hosted.

serena: for embeddings+rerank we should lock on accuracy baselines (MRR) and a perf envelope. also need eval datasets from sales for top 3 customers. @noah can you get those?

noah: yep — I'll pull sample queries from Atlas & Meridian customers and drop in the shared drive by EOD Wed. will anonymize.

alex: devex will need SDK changes: new per-route timeout config + rollout flags. also want to add migration guide for teams moving from self-hosted to Hosted API. estimate 2 sprints.

liam: tentative perf targets proposal: chat p95 <= 300ms for 1-2k token sessions, completions p95 <= 200ms for short prompts, embeddings p95 <= 50ms for single vector, rerank end-to-end p95 <= 450ms for 100 candidate batches. cost guardrails: aim to keep unit cost within 15% of current baseline for Hosted.

serena: embedding 50ms p95 is aggressive depending on quantization and batching. we can hit it for small dims (512) but need fallback routing for large-dim or multi-vector requests. propose automatic routing to a cold pool with higher latency but cheaper inference if batch size > 16.

maya: good — let's make fallback explicit in rollout plan. we also need launch criteria checklist items: security review complete, KMS integration verified, docs + migration guide, 3 external customer signoffs, and automated canary with rollback.

liam: canary config draft:
```
canary: 5% traffic -> model-variant v2
monitoring: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost, model-quality delta on eval set
rollback: >3% increase in error-rate OR >10% regression in eval metric over 1h
```

alex: tagging on docs: add explicit troubleshooting steps for common failures (tokenization mismatch, cache warmup, rate-limit errors). we'll also surface token-level cost breakdown in Console by route.

noah: from GTM perspective, customers care about determinism for rerank and embedding drift. propose a partner pilot phase: 6 customers for 6 weeks, include SLA credits if we miss p95 by >20%.

serena: ML ops asks: we need per-request sample logging, hashed inputs for privacy, and eval hooks to compute regressed examples automatically. also need a plan to retrain/refresh reranker latent features monthly.

maya: timeline suggestion: week 1-2 finalize SLA & perf targets, week 3-4 implement canary hooks + telemetry, week 5 pilot with partners, week 7 GA if pilots pass. owners: liam (perf), serena (quality), alex (docs/devex), noah (pilots).

liam: blockers: infra capacity planning (Dedicated pools) and kernel rollout for quantized embed kernels. I'll open infra PR today.

ops-bot: automated note: infra PR #512 opened by liam, requested reviewers eng-infra.

maya: thanks — I'll consolidate this into a launch checklist doc and assign tasks. please drop objections or cost constraints by EOD tomorrow so we can lock targets. :thumbsup:

alex: +1. also want a one-pager for sales with clear tradeoffs and migration steps.

noah: will draft sales one-pager after we lock the SLA and pilot terms.

serena: adding a risk note: rerank quality regression can be subtle. recommend gating GA on no >2% MRR drop across pilot customers.

maya: noted. closing for now — I'll create the doc and link it here. if anything urgent ping me directly.
